description: Check a job ad, job posting or vacancy text against pay transparency rules: is a salary range, minimum pay, benefits or a pay-history question required, found or missing for this employer and jurisdiction. Text checks are heuristics; the result is not a finding that the ad complies or does not comply with the law. The ad text is not stored. Use this for: a draft ad or a planned pay range. Not for: writing the ad, or job-ad law outside pay (discrimination, language, work permits).

ad_text.description: The job ad, job posting or vacancy text. Remove names, e-mail addresses and phone numbers of people first; they are not needed.

collective_agreement_applies.description: true if a collective (bargaining) agreement sets the pay.

employees_in_jurisdiction.description: Employees in that jurisdiction, if different from the total.

employer_headcount.description: Number of employees (staff, workforce size) of the employer.

jurisdiction.description: Country, US state or Canadian province code from list_jurisdictions, e.g. AT (Austria), IT (Italy), MT (Malta), PL (Poland), SK (Slovakia), US-CA (California), US-NY (New York), CA-ON (Ontario).

pay_period.description: Whether the pay figures are per year (annual salary), per month or per hour.

posting_type.description: external job ad, internal vacancy, promotion, transfer, or a posting by a third-party recruiter.

range_max.description: Highest salary or pay in the ad, if not in the text.

range_min.description: Lowest salary or pay in the ad, if not in the text.

remote.description: true if the role is remote (work from home) and not based in the jurisdiction.

name: check_job_ad
title: Check job ad
